_comment: Conductor stage/tier -> agent map. The single source for which .claude/agents/* persona handles each pipeline stage or model tier. Both /conduct (Agent tool subagent_type) and conductor.sh (claude -p --agent) resolve through conductor/lib/agents.sh (agents::for_stage / agents::for_tier / agents::for_phase). A phase's `agent:` frontmatter overrides this map. keese ships 13 specialized personas; see docs/designs/29-conductor-orchestration.md.
